answer: Anyone thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The sable counter is kept in falcon and bridge publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4996 identities would post 1364 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
